ComponentState.title: ComponentState
ComponentState.description: Represents the real-time physical indicators and hazard assessment of an aviation component.

id.description: Unique identifier of the component node.

name.description: Readable name of the structural element.

stress.description: Calculated real-time stress load coefficient from 0 to 100.

isFailed.description: Indicates if stress exceeded hazard tolerance thresholds.

rulHours.description: Pre-calculated Remaining Useful Life metric in operational hours.

actionRequired.description: Prescriptive actions to correct current structural discrepancy.

updatedAt.description: The ISO timestamp representing when the node state was computed.

AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description: An aerospace audit certificate documenting corrective action or traveled work tracking.

id.description: Unique auto-generated ID of the QA entry.

timestamp.description: The date and time of file entry.

inspectorEmail.description: Regulatory trackability identity of the inspecting engineer.

category.description: Categorization of discrepancy (e.g., Shimming, Torque, Traveled Work, Fatigue, Corrosion).

status.description: The compliance state assigned to this structural log.

notes.description: Anomalies, torque compliance values, or traveled work observations.

/component_states/{componentId}.description: Tracks and syncs real-time physical digital twin indicator parameters.

/audit_records/{auditId}.description: A ledger of inspections, torque verifications, and traveled work compliance certifications.
